## scrape 
```{r scrape_alaska_page}
# load packages 
library(tidyverse) 
library(rvest)

## first URL 

url <- "https://www.bfro.net/GDB/state_listing.asp?state=ak" 

page <- read_html(url) 
headers <- page %>% 
html_nodes(".countytbl") %>% 
html_text() %>% 
str_squish()
```
